instruction: Read the requirements file located on the Desktop, turn the image 90 degrees to the right, and save it as 'pic.jpg' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires rotating the image 90 degrees clockwise. Original image is 320x510 (portrait). After 90-degree clockwise rotation, it becomes 510x320 (landscape). The evaluator verifies both the orientation change and the swapped dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts image orientation and dimensions from the output file path (/home/user/Desktop/pic.jpg)
Orientation detection logic is sound: landscape when width > height, portrait when height > width
Expected values are semantically correct: 510x320 (landscape) correctly represents 90-degree clockwise rotation from original 320x510 (portrait)
Complete coverage: verifies both orientation change (portrait to landscape) and exact dimension swap
Metric logic correctly compares orientation, width, and height against expected values
No timing or state issues - evaluator reads from a saved file on disk
Implementation uses PIL for reliable image dimension extraction
